title: Senior Software Engineer (Go)
description:
THE ROLE 📝  

As a Senior Software Engineer at Form3, you’ll work on established, high-volume services that sit at the heart of Form3’s cloud-native payment platform. These are critical systems where reliability, resilience and operational excellence matter every single day. 

This is a role for engineers who enjoy evolving critical systems at scale. You’ll be working on mature, high-volume services where thoughtful design, careful testing, operational discipline and reliability are just as important as delivering new capability. 

You’ll solve complex engineering challenges across services that support real-time payment flows, high availability, fault tolerance, security and performance within a microservice architecture. You’ll need to think carefully about how changes are designed, tested, released and operated, balancing delivery speed with the discipline required for mission-critical financial infrastructure.  

You’ll work closely with experienced engineers, product teams and operational stakeholders to improve, evolve and run services that customers depend on. This could include enhancing existing payment capabilities, improving service resilience, simplifying complex systems, reducing operational risk, or building new functionality into mature services without compromising stability.

title: Senior Manager / Director Sales - Europe
description:
Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture. ​

For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving.  But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world.  Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.  

 

The Senior Manager / Director Sales - Europe reports to the GM – Regional Sales & Service and is responsible for driving sales growth, customer satisfaction, and account management and execution for strategic semiconductor customers. The role owns day-to-day account management, commercial activities, sales planning, forecasting, and cross-functional coordination to ensure successful execution of ASM's product and service sales strategy. 

The Senior Manager / Director Sales - Europe serves as the primary commercial interface for assigned product lines and works closely with Business Units, Product Management, Service, Process Engineering, and Operations to deliver customer success and achieve revenue objectives.

title: Content Writer (B2B SaaS, Remote - EU/UK)
description:
SaaStorm is a fully remote organic growth agency for B2B SaaS, headquartered in London with a team spread across Europe. Since founding in 2024, we've grown to work with SaaS companies from pre-seed through Series C, and we're approaching €1.5M ARR.
 What makes us different is the bet we've made: search is changing, and the companies that win the next five years will be the ones cited by LLMs, not just ranked by Google. We've built our delivery model around that thesis, combining traditional organic growth with AEO/LLM visibility work, and we report on pipeline impact rather than vanity metrics.
 In this role, you’ll be responsible for producing high-quality content that supports our SEO and content strategy - helping drive measurable outcomes such as sign-ups, MQLs, SQLs, pipeline, and long-term brand value for both SaaStorm and our B2B SaaS clients.
 You’ll work closely with our strategists and delivery team to turn briefs, research, and positioning into clear, compelling, conversion-aware content that meets quality standards and deadlines.
 Tasks
 Own content writing for 2-4 B2B SaaS clients (you'll be writing for the same clients mostly, so you'll be able to learn their product, ICP and use cases).
 Produce 15-17 long-form articles/month for our B2B SaaS clients (primarily SEO/AEO-focused content)
 Write content that is clear, well-structured, and aligned with the brief, brand voice, and target audience
 Apply SEO writing best practices (search intent alignment, on-page structure, internal linking notes, basic keyword integration)
 Conduct research and incorporate credible sources, product context, and customer pain points into your writing
 Collaborate with the team to clarify briefs, messaging, and scope when needed
